Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Rajendra Dobhal, Senior Advocate 
assisted by Mr. Devang Dobhal, Advocate for the 
petitioner.
Mr. I.P.Kohli, Advocate for the 
respondents.
These are the two connected matters, 
which are listed today on an urgency application, 
which had been preferred by the petitioner on the 
ground that during the pendency of the first Writ 
Petition No. 2249 of 2018, his services has been 
prematurely retired, which has also been subject 
matter of consequences of the connected Writ 
Petition No. 896 of 2019.
Considering the facts and circumstances of 
the case, the urgency application being IA No. 
10134 of 2021 in writ petition no. 2249 of 2018 
would stand allowed, and the writ petitions are
directed to be listed in the week commencing 
21.02.2022, till the next date of listing the interim 
order dated 16.04.2019, already granted in Writ 
Petition No. 896 of 2019 would continue to 
operate till the next date of listing.
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 10.01.2022
Nahid
